content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIIT Surat to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIIT Surat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIIT Surat Visiting Faculty, Assistant Professor, and Teaching Assistant posts is 13th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIIT Surat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Visiting Faculty, Assistant Professor, and Teaching Assistant positions at IIIT Surat.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIIT Surat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for IIIT Surat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: For the Assistant Professor position in Computer Science and Engineering, candidates need a First Class B.Tech/BE, M.Tech/ME, and Ph.D. in a relevant discipline from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Teaching Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Teaching Assistant (Computer Science and Engineering) will receive a salary of ₹ 60,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for these positions. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the IIIT Surat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions at IIIT Surat is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Indian Institute of Information Technology Surat, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring all relevant original certificates, mark sheets, and other supporting documents for verification during the walk-in interview.
